name: Will of the Abzan
oracle_text:
Choose one. If you control a commander as you cast this spell, you may choose both instead.
• Any number of target opponents each sacrifice a creature with the greatest power among creatures that player controls and lose 3 life.
• Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
blocked_sentences: • Any number of target opponents each sacrifice a creature with the greatest power among creatures that player controls and lose 3 life

needs.what: a caster-sized ("any number of target opponents": count 'any' / up_to with min_count 0) mode-owned target in a mode that is NOT the last mode owning a target -- here mode 0 owns a variable-size player target and mode 1 owns 'target creature card from your graveyard'. Needs the stored target refs to be split per spec by recorded size (or per-mode buckets) rather than by position, so a variable-size spec can be followed by later modes' targets
needs.why_existing_wont_do: loader.targets._check_mode_targets refuses an optional or variable-size mode-owned target unless _ends_every_declaration holds (last spec of its mode and no later mode owns a target), because targeting.filter_legal splits stored refs by position. Making mode 1's graveyard target card-level instead would force it to be declared when only mode 0 is chosen; fixing mode 0's count would change 'any number' to an exact number. The rest is expressible: choose_mode with up_to_if on an is_commander exists condition (as Will of the Jeskai/Mardu), for_each_player over {target: t1} with a sacrifice using extreme greatest power and chooser owner (as Crackling Doom) plus lose_life 3, and return_from_graveyard for mode 1
